manual_notes: Bulk duplicate-ignore ingest and visibility-paused backend probing are implemented. Full backpressure scope is unresolved: SDK error normalization does not propagate Retry-After to retryAfterMs, while uploader throttling caps supplied retry-after at 30 minutes. The 60-second minimum can satisfy the example accidentally but does not establish honoring server signals generally. This is a requirement gap, not abandonment.
